mobbin:79f64251-2c1a-4751-9926-1ab5aa922.summary: User arms a slide+cam studio, starts Record, sees a cancelable countdown, records with timer/pause/retake/stop, then lands in a post-stop editor with upload progress and Add to project.
steal: Countdown overlay with Click anywhere to cancel and Starting status before REC (step Countdown 2).
During capture: elapsed/limit timer plus Retake, Pause, Stop as peer actions (step Recording — timer).
Paused state flips primary CTA to red Resume while Retake/Stop remain (step Paused — Resume primary).
After stop: immediate review player + Uploading % then Add to project / Delete (steps Post-stop editor / Add to project).
avoid: Scenes upsell modal on pause distracts from Resume/Stop for operators who only need recording-state control.
mobbin:79f64251-2c1a-4751-9926-1ab5aa922.fit: Maps to control-room start-stop outside SRV (countdown, pause/retake, post-stop processing indicator); SRV itself stays the review surface once the asset exists.

mobbin:e774e41f-3fa0-4fe8-90a9-a784b9336.summary: On the armed record stage the user opens mic source menu, chooses Mute Microphone, then sees a top warning Your microphone is muted. Unmute plus a red Unmute control before Record.
steps: Mic menu — Mute Microphone in red
Muted toolbar state persists with Record CTA
steal: In-view banner: Your microphone is muted. Unmute with dismiss, above the stage (step Muted banner).
Toolbar Unmute turns red with slash while Record remains available — warning does not silently block (step Muted banner).
Mic dropdown lists devices and a red Mute Microphone action as an explicit decision (step Mic menu).
mobbin:e774e41f-3fa0-4fe8-90a9-a784b9336.fit: Pre-session / live-control guardrail outside SRV: explicit muted-mic warning before or during arming — addresses the baseline audio-failed-at-centers pain without changing Transcript/Annotation tabs.
